text: Steenbarger: none is answered, so ADVANCE should not stand on h1_close_above:bar_high. My clearing condition is in_zone:ma_20 D: Elder buys the pullback into a rising average (C6, C10), not the expansion over yesterday's high. `elder` 10.0 is a plateau, summer (C20); D 10.4% over the swing high with `subcomponents.energy.en_pos50` 86.92 is a chase. A two-seat tie on blind conviction does not answer six objections. I support the name, not this trigger. Clears on a daily pullback into the 20-day average with `elder` 7 or higher (not red, C3).
